authority_citations: ANC-015 v3 scope (bead-level signals 1-3, approved by arch-ai)

item.text: judge-jev's records name the tool and its own behaviour and point to sc-agent for the logging rule.
item.title: fixture-pass

cases.rationale: ANC-015 v3 recorded pass fixture; edits a derivative tool's records (scope signal 1) and states the one-source rule.

item.text: judge-jev's REQ restates sc-agent's log-root and model-resolution rules in full.
item.title: fixture-fail

cases.rationale: ANC-015 v3 recorded fail fixture; a derivative tool's REQ restating shared rules is the prohibited act.

item.text: Rewrite plan-anchor's NFR-PA-0003 to say only 'plan-anchor follows sc-agent's logging rules (NFR-SAG-0012)' plus plan-anchor's own log file name.
item.title: compliant

cases.rationale: Statement: derivative tool gives only tool name and own behaviour and defers to sc-agent; scope signal 1.

item.text: Copy sc-agent's model-resolution rule into judge-jev's ADR so judge-jev's records are complete on their own.
item.title: conflicting

cases.rationale: Statement: a derivative tool's records must not restate a shared rule; model resolution is named in the statement.

item.text: Add a plan-anchor REQ for the coverage subcommand's output format.
item.title: silent

cases.rationale: Scope signal 1 (adds a REQ of plan-anchor); the content is the tool's own behaviour and neither states nor breaks the rule; prohibition silence is compliance.

item.text: judge-jev's REQ states judge-jev writes quality results to the judge_jev_results table.
item.title: exception

cases.rationale: Statement explicitly allows the tool's own behaviour in its records; scope signal 1.

item.text: Add an sc-agent NFR that states the retry rule for all decidr-based tools, and delete the copies of that rule from judge-jev's and plan-anchor's REQs so each cites the sc-agent NFR.
item.title: boundary-sc-agent-rule

cases.rationale: Scope signal 3 (sc-agent record stating a rule for all tools) and signal 1; consolidating the rule in sc-agent is what the statement requires.

item.text: Reword the log-root paragraph of sc-agent's NFR-SAG-0012 for clarity; its meaning does not change.
item.title: boundary-reword-log-root

cases.rationale: Scope signal 2 (rewords log-root text in a record) and signal 3; the rule stays in sc-agent only, so no restatement; it does not state the one-source rule.

item.text: Rename the parse_args helper in crates/sc-cli/src/main.rs to parse_cli_args and update its callers.
item.title: irrelevant-rename

cases.rationale: Plain code change touching no record; matches no scope signal.

item.text: Bump the serde dependency to 1.0.215 in the workspace Cargo.toml and fix any compile warnings.
item.title: irrelevant-dep-bump

cases.rationale: Plain code change touching no record; matches no scope signal.

item.text: Change the retry back-off in crates/sc-jev-client/src/retry.rs from a fixed 2 s wait to exponential back-off; no requirement, NFR or ADR text changes.
item.title: irrelevant-retry-code

cases.rationale: Code-only change; scope signal 2 requires record text about retries, and the item states no record text changes.

item.text: Fix a bug in sc-agent's session-log writer so every line is flushed to disk; no requirement, NFR or ADR text changes.

cases.rationale: Mentions log root and judge-jev but changes no record; no scope signal applies.

item.text: Read judge-jev's and plan-anchor's requirement records to learn how they handle logging before starting the SQLite session-log work; no record is changed.
